metadata.boundaryNote: 默认优先使用各市政府正式命名社区、规划区；缺少可用市级分区时采用区域政府的命名社区，仍无覆盖处才补充联邦普查区。各分区的来源可在详情查看。普查统计区图层独立保留原始2021年普查边界。
metadata.missingDataNote: 社区原表仅展示对应边界的资料；缺项由独立的相交统计区资料补充，可直接选择并查看其完整范围。底色使用对应统计区完整数值，不将人口分摊或平均中位数当作社区统计。Brampton另明确标注2022年市府发布人口估算。
metadata.scopeNote: 同名社区在不同城市分别标识。跨市区域只显示本市部分时，不沿用整个区域的人口与收入。地图名称是所引政府数据的正式名称，不代表所有民间街区或地产片区。
metadata.childrenDefinition: Toronto社区使用市政府2021年社区定制表的0–14岁比例（25%抽样）；其他区域仅使用对应官方表的同年龄指标。

english.boundaryNote: The default layer prioritizes official municipal neighbourhoods and planning areas, then named regional-government neighbourhoods. Federal census areas fill remaining gaps. Each area links to its boundary source. The separate census layer preserves the original 2021 boundaries.
english.missingDataNote: Community profiles contain only matching statistics. Linked overlapping statistical areas supply additional figures with their full boundaries. Shading retains complete statistical-area values; population is never apportioned and medians are never averaged into community statistics. Brampton population estimates are explicitly labelled 2022.
english.scopeNote: Neighbourhoods with the same name in different municipalities remain separate. Where a cross-border neighbourhood is clipped to a municipality, full-area statistics are not reused. Names follow the cited government datasets and do not enumerate every informal or real-estate neighbourhood.
english.childrenDefinition: Toronto neighbourhoods use the published age 0–14 percentage in the City custom 2021 profile (25% sample). Elsewhere only corresponding official age indicators are used.
english.license: Contains municipal and regional government information from the credited sources; source-specific licences and attribution are recorded in the repository manifests.
